newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Fore says disregard Asia forecast.
newsitem.headline: Fore says disregard Asia forecast.

text.p: U.S. computer network communications company Fore Systems said that a forecast given by an employee on Asian revenues should be disregarded.
Fore was responding to a Reuters report on July 30, which quoted a Fore employee in Singapore that revenue from Asia was expected to double in the current fiscal year.
It said in a statement issued late on Thursday from its New York headquarters the report was based on an unauthorized interview and contained inaccurate information.
"As a matter of policy, the company does not publish sales forecasts, either in general or by region, and the information
in the story should be disregarded," it said.

Fore said that, as it had said before, the company's sales in Asia represented 16 percent of worldwide sales in the fiscal year ended March 31, 1997, and for the first quarter of the current fiscal year represented four percent of revenue.
In the interview the employee said Asian operations contributed about 20 to 25 percent of worldwide sales.
